propositions: A test fixture bare repository created with `git init --bare` at git defaults spawns a detached background `git maintenance run` process after a push, which outlives the push and concurrently mutates the object database while the next statement attempts to copytree the repository, causing race-dependent failures on loose-object fanout directories and maintenance.lock.

The fixture bare remote must be pinned with `receive.autogc=false`, `gc.autoDetach=false`, and `maintenance.autoDetach=false` before any push occurs, eliminating the background mutator entirely (receive.autogc drops maintenance children to zero; the autoDetach pins force any other trigger into foreground).

A guard test must assert the mutator's absence by running the push under GIT_TRACE2_EVENT and verifying no spawned `git maintenance run` child carries `--detach`, with a receive-pack positive control to prevent vacuous pass.

Filtering `*.lock` from the copy or retrying the copytree would narrow the race window without removing the concurrent mutator; the fix must eliminate the mutator as a structural property of the fixture.
